name: axi-loop-host
title: The loop's own host: start under the boundary, and dispatch the improver under it
description: The milestone 'src/commands/axi-turn.ts' says belongs later: a turn of axi's own loop that ensures the Plane B boundary at startup and dispatches the improver's work through 'launchJailed', so the improver is started by the helper process and never by itself. Definition of done is the one the specs already state: the six 'src/jailer' entries leave the reachability allow-list because something in the runtime reaches them.
creator: aixi
